admission.justification: The union merge alone would let a duplicated or interleaved catalog through, the canonical-form refusal alone would bring back a hand repair at every sync, and the command alone stops nothing; only together do they give a merge that neither conflicts nor lands damage.

guarantee: Two changes that extend the two test catalogs independently are merged by Git without a conflict. A merge result that holds a line twice, a list out of order, the line of a deleted file or two interleaved rows is refused by the loaders before a test run or a delivery relies on it. One command that makes no decision repairs order, duplicate lines, derived consumer lists and the lines of deleted files.
title: Shared test catalogs merge without conflict and without an unchecked result
